document_semantics: Admit and structurally validate the complete original Document with evaluator.CompileDomainSnapshotV2; never prune the Document, substitute a trusted hash, infer offered capabilities, or relax V1. Retain original asset/timeline/track/clip/bus indexes and canonical document identity. Inputs are borrowed immutable until compilation returns.
failure_semantics: Nil context, cancellation, invalid inputs, limits, unsupported graph and unexpected panic return zero authority/results. Context checked through admission, binding and timeline loops and before publication; provider/context panic values are never formatted. Owned getters and immutable state support concurrent readers. Evaluation DSP ProfileV1 and legacy profiles/fixtures remain unchanged.
guard_semantics: Before provider IO or block allocation, check audio authority, selected timeline and exact half-open time membership even in silent gaps. Sample indexes and block first/count must be nonnegative and overflow-free. Check exact SampleClock start and exclusive block endpoint, not rounded ticks or last sample alone; endpoint may equal requested end. Zero blocks require their start strictly inside requested range and a valid clock/index. Limits bound all original input admission and block memory, not RSS or synchronous validation/canonicalization execution time.
receipt_semantics: Owned schema-version-2 receipt binds original Document hash, sorted owned scope, normalized limits, the unchanged fixed offered declaration, separate V2 domain/evaluator and unchanged DSP descriptor hashes, and actually selected source identities with original indexes and binding profiles. Scope plus full Document hash binds selected bus routing. Receipt hash omits receipt_hash entirely. No provider attestation, raw graph, evaluator, snapshot or retained mutable pointer escapes.
scope_semantics: Audio only; exact positive half-open requested range and complete enabled same-domain clip intersection independently checked by evaluator against caller-supplied fixed offered capabilities. Bind only distinct selected audio assets and reject extra bindings. No visual IO or visual rendering authority. Selected TransitionIDs must be empty; purely visual authored transitions may coexist but never authorize audio transitions or transition handles.
supported_graph: Reuse existing DSP ProfileV1: implicit direct master or explicit AudioBus routes, ancestor groups and master; exact mono/stereo or explicit channel matrix; clip gain/pan and their existing automation; bus gain/pan and master sample-peak limiter. Compile only selected route roots and their ancestors in original Document.AudioBuses order, preserving original BusIndex and direct-track/child-bus order. Empty selections compile silent implicit master with no bus capability claim. Reject selected rendering extensions and nonunit source/timeline duration ratios. Unselected audio and visual graphs remain fully structurally validated but are not bound or rendered.
